# Doxastic Tenure

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:DoxasticTenure`](gmeow-DoxasticTenure.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DoxasticTenure>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/epistemics`](../../slices/epistemics.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reified, time-scoped fact that a [`DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md) was held over an interval — the belief-revision history construct. Opened when the belief is adopted; closed ([`endedAtTime`](../properties/gmeow-endedAtTime.md) on the [`duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md)) and suppressed with displayable false when the belief is revised or retracted. The old [`DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md) is retained as audit, never deleted ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)). Carries its interval via [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md) (temporal module) and links to the scoped [`DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md) via [`tenureOfDoxasticState`](../properties/gmeow-tenureOfDoxasticState.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:DoxasticTenure`](gmeow-DoxasticTenure.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:TimeScopedRelation`](gmeow-TimeScopedRelation.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when the adoption, revision, or retraction of a belief over time is itself the fact of interest — the heavy form for belief-revision history.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the lightweight case where a bare [`gmeow:believes`](../properties/gmeow-believes.md) statement with [`validFrom`](../properties/gmeow-validFrom.md)/validUntil suffices; reify on demand ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).

### How to use

- Mint one [`DoxasticTenure`](gmeow-DoxasticTenure.md) per [`DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md) adoption interval; point it at the [`DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md) via [`tenureOfDoxasticState`](../properties/gmeow-tenureOfDoxasticState.md) and at a [`TimeInterval`](gmeow-TimeInterval.md) via [`duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md). On revision, close the interval with [`endedAtTime`](../properties/gmeow-endedAtTime.md) and set displayable false on the tenure; mint a new [`DoxasticState`](gmeow-DoxasticState.md) and tenure for the revised belief.

### Examples

- ex:aliceRoundTenure a [`gmeow:DoxasticTenure`](gmeow-DoxasticTenure.md); [`gmeow:tenureOfDoxasticState`](../properties/gmeow-tenureOfDoxasticState.md) ex:aliceBelievesRound; [`gmeow:duringInterval`](../properties/gmeow-duringInterval.md) ex:2019to2024.
